reviews.model: claude-opus-5-5 via Claude Code session (owner Pro plan, no API cost)

result.thesis: A well-run, net-cash industrial gas utility adding capacity: a 325 TPD take-or-pay onsite plant (Jai Balaji) started 25 Sep 2026, two merchant plants (~450-500 TPD) under construction, and a Rs481 cr BHEL ASU build-and-transfer order. Core growth is real but moderate (revenue +18%, company EBITDA +21% YoY). Reported PAT +87% is mostly other income on IPO cash, lower interest and tax. At ~43x reported and ~68x core earnings the price already assumes steady compounding; this is not a Sandisk-type inflection.
chain_missing_links: Industry change: industrial gas demand grows ~7.5%/yr (company-cited F&S); no shortage evident
Pricing: oxygen/nitrogen prices flat and contractual; argon recovering but below H1 FY26
Operating leverage: EBITDA growth only slightly above revenue growth YoY
EPS acceleration is non-operating (other income 37% of FY26 PBT)
Valuation gap: none; multiple already high
result.demand_signal: Steel capacity build-out (~35% of revenue) and >600 TPD onsite enquiries (MANAGEMENT CLAIM); National Coal Gasification Mission needs large ASUs (policy FACT, company benefit ASSUMPTION).
result.supply_signal: Argon supply is tied to oxygen capacity (structural, per management); merchant markets are regional oligopolies with Linde/Inox/Air Liquide; new merchant plants start without contracts and need 18-24 months to ramp, so no evident shortage.
result.pricing_signal: O2/N2 stable; argon recovered from Q3 FY26 low but below H1 FY26 (MANAGEMENT CLAIM). Weak pricing-power evidence.
result.order_book: BHEL Rs481 cr turnkey 1,200 TPD ASU, build-and-transfer over 8 quarters, commissioning FY29 (FACT), roughly 1.3x FY26 revenue, but project-engineering margins are typically far below gas margins (ASSUMPTION). 15-year onsite contracts are take-or-pay.
result.capacity_catalyst: 1,933 TPD incl. 320-325 TPD East India onsite commissioned 25 Sep 2026 (FACT); North India 220 TPD bulk and West/Central bulk (~450-500 TPD combined) under construction; capex guidance Rs250 cr FY27, Rs200 cr FY28. Legacy plants fully utilized; Uluberia-2 ramping.
result.cfo_to_pat: FY26 CFO Rs1,325m vs PAT Rs1,044m = 1.27 (FACT); receivables fell 826 to 633m on revenue +9%; FCF negative from capex (class A productive growth investment).
result.debt: Borrowings ~Rs180 cr vs ~Rs520 cr investments/deposits/loans at FY26 end: net cash (CALCULATION); Crisil A/Stable, A1 reaffirmed 28 Sep 2026 (FACT).
result.roce: Core EBITDA/invested capital ~12-14% (CALCULATION); management targets project ROCE >15%.
result.valuation: Price Rs369.35, mcap ~Rs5,205 cr (141m shares). TTM PAT Rs1,207m gives P/E ~43; ex other income (after tax) ~68x; EV/core EBITDA ~40x. Below the Rs400 IPO price (Jul 2025).

bear.assumptions: Gas revenue +10%/yr, argon falls, merchant ramps slow, margin 35%, other income falls as cash is spent; exit on FY30 EPS.

base.assumptions: Gas revenue +18%/yr from new plants, 40% gas EBITDA margin, BHEL EPC at ~12% margin, D&A rises with capex; exit on FY30 EPS about 3.5 years out.

bull.assumptions: Gas revenue +25%/yr incl. a >600 TPD onsite win, margin 42%, argon firm; exit on FY30 EPS.

extreme_bull.assumptions: Several 1,000+ TPD own-and-operate contracts from coal gasification and steel, gas revenue +35%/yr; exit on FY32 EPS.

plausible.2x: NO in base; YES only in bull: ~25% gas revenue CAGR plus a 45x exit multiple in ~3.5 years.
plausible.3x: NO: needs multiple large onsite wins and a rising multiple.

kill_conditions: Q2 FY27 gas revenue growth below 15% YoY despite the Jai Balaji plant
Company EBITDA margin (ex other income) below 36% for two quarters
North India / West-Central plants delayed beyond FY28
Receivable days above 90 or CFO/PAT below 0.8
Large acquisition or related-party transaction using IPO cash
catalysts: Q2 FY27 results (~Nov 2026): first Jai Balaji onsite revenue
result.biggest_risk: Paying ~68x core earnings for a business growing core EBITDA ~20%: multiple contraction can offset growth for years.
result.next_datapoint: Q2 FY27 result: core EBITDA growth and margin with a full month of Jai Balaji onsite revenue.
